quests.name: Vorrel's Revenge
quests.objective: Return Vorrel Sengutz's wedding ring (from Nancy Vishas) to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: The Horn of Xelthos
quests.objective: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village. You must complete the job alone.
quests.description: Solo job: you must do it alone, outside any group.

start.description: Dead Drop, Pyrewood Village, Silverpine Forest

quests.name: The Horn of Xelthos
quests.objective: Collect C's payment from the Dead Drop near Pyrewood Village.
quests.description:
Rogue class quest. C's letter arrives at level 20 in a capital city; take the job at the Dead Drop near Pyrewood Village. Keep a bag slot free.

Solo job: you must do it alone, outside any group.

quests.name: The Eye of Bhossca
quests.objective: Collect C's payment from the Dead Drop near Pyrewood Village.
quests.description:
Rogue class quest after The Horn of Xelthos; C's next letter (around level 30) sends you back to the Dead Drop. Wear the Scarlet Initiate's Uniform in every wing: stealth or attacking removes it.

Solo job: you must do it alone, outside any group.
